name: Meridiani
convention: East-positive longitude from -180 to 180 and planetocentric latitude, in degrees. Heights in metres relative to the areoid.

grid.rowOrder: north row first; within a row, west cell first

files.name: heightM
files.meaning: Mean terrain height of the 4 x 4 source cells in the routing cell, relative to the areoid.

files.name: slopeMaxDeg
files.meaning: Steepest slope found among the 4 x 4 source cells in the routing cell. Each source cell's slope is measured over 6.071 m north to south and 6.067 m east to west. Use it for keep-out; for effort use the slope along the direction of travel, taken from heightM.

readFrom.terrain: local working copy, first read from the team data server, warped from its own projection onto the app's grid
readFrom.image: local working copy, first read from the team data server, warped from its own projection onto the app's grid
